Provenance. The 49r1 values are the control.mean arrays from ECMWF’s “AIFS v2/50r1 vs AIFS v1.1/49r1” page. The 50r1 values are the control.mean arrays from “AIFS v2/50r1 vs AIFS v1.1/50r1”. Observation rows share the same observation type and are more defensible, but their populations still differ by one case. Exact date membership and paired-bootstrap significance cannot be reconstructed from the HTML. Forecast activity uses the same red-to-blue scale for visual consistency, but “more active” and “less active” are not themselves better/worse skill judgements.
